stem: A rectangular banner for a school fair in Karachi has an area of 1,200 square centimeters and a width of 30 centimeters. A ribbon is sewn along the entire edge of the banner. What is the length of the ribbon, in centimeters?
solution: The ribbon runs around the whole edge, so its length is the perimeter: \(2(40 + 30) = 140\) centimeters.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is \(40 + 30\), only half the perimeter; the banner has two lengths and two widths.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(2 \cdot 40\), the two long edges only; the two short edges also need ribbon.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(40 + 30 + 30\), which leaves out one of the \(40\)-centimeter edges.
explanation.D: Correct. The length is \(1{,}200 \div 30 = 40\), and the perimeter is \(2(40 + 30) = 140\).

verify:
L=Rational(1200,30)
assert L==40
ans=2*(L+30)
assert ans==140
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
